mentions.name: webpipe
mentions.description: This is an experimental DSL for writing web applications. It is pipeline-oriented, polyglot, and loosely inspired by Bash pipelines, with a Rust runtime, a fully-featured TypeScript language server (jump to definition, hover, etc.), full DAP debugging, and a BDD-style testing framework built into the language.
